newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Withdrawals from Israel provident funds decline.
newsitem.headline: Withdrawals from Israel provident funds decline.

text.p: Israeli provident funds in July posted net redemptions of 111.5 million shekels against net withdrawals of 158 million in June and 943 million in July 1996, the Treasury said on Wednesday.
Since the beginning of the year net withdrawals amounted to 1.6 billion shekels against 11.9 billion in all of 1996.
Provident funds are long-term savings funds that enjoy special tax benefits. They are key players in the Israeli stock market.
In July there were net deposits of 160 million shekels in savings account against net withdrawals of 53 million in June and net deposits of 832 million in July 1996.
Since the beginning of the year net withdrawals from savings accounts totalled 1.2 billion shekels against net deposits of 5.4 billion in all of 1996.
